note: FX5 keys on an own planet at peace (quick-1.sav, planet 42; re/screens/colony.md §11.2, §12.1): End (vk 0x23) changes nothing (remapKeyCodes exe 0x4e4670 queues no key down for SDLK_END), the character i (SDL_TEXTINPUT; a bare key down carries only the virtual key) turns the info mode on, a key down of i alone does nothing, I (text) turns it off and End again changes nothing. Times are UI ticks.
